It writes one record in two halves, the stack's states with citation dates and the person's own half in their words, and the lead writes nothing in their own voice; the lead reads the record aloud as specific acts on specific services, which is the formal half of "you really have talent." items.name: Founder decision: Ratify the compensation architecture's form: two layers, one pool per day, the four inputs and the refused inputs, the day, the daily calculation, and the payment rhythm
items.desc:
P22, P23, P24, P36, P37. Every person on the roster holds base pay (an hourly wage per edge seat or a salary per salaried seat, the same for everyone in the seat, which the record never describes and everywhere assumes) and the pool (the day's built-in share, a defined proportion of a defined base, computed by the stack at every close); the base must not shrink when the generosity range is used, so a comped item counts at menu price and recovery spend does not reduce the day's pool; there is one pool per calendar day for the whole house across every open period and never a pool per period, with the alternative stated. A person's points are set by four things on records the person can read and nothing else: the seat's published weight at the horizon held, moved by a recorded unlock on its date; the markers while current; the days worked; and the salaried day-weight rule. Never by a review, a check-in, a rating, a designation, a recognition, any lead's judgment, a lagging indicator, a customer's rating, a sales attribution, hours, a period, tenure, history, or a negotiation; no person moves points by hand. A day is a calendar day with any scheduled shift in any period, counted once, every paid block counting as shift. The share is on the pay page by the next morning and is paid with base pay on the same pay date and never on a slower cycle. Review and pay are separated by design, and her "pay for performance" is carried by the unlock, the markers, the pool's weighting, and the days, with no differential reward for doing the same seat better and no pay tier added by any later session.
